title: The sheaf of differentials of a morphism of algebraic spaces is quasi-coherent
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces), section on the sheaf of differentials

difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a morphism of algebraic spaces f : X -> Y over a scheme S the sheaf of differentials Omega_{X/Y} is a quasi-coherent O_X-module (statement lines 1018-1019). The proof is a reduction to the scheme case along a presentation: the localisation lemma supplies a diagram with surjective maps from schemes U and V, the restriction of Omega_{X/Y} to U is identified with Omega_{U/V}, which is quasi-coherent by the scheme-theoretic statement, and quasi-coherence on X follows from the criterion phrased in terms of a presentation (proof lines 1023-1031). The two steps that carry the content are the identification on the presented piece and the appeal to the presentation criterion. The claim is H2: no construction beyond the diagram, three cited inputs.
